title: San Francisco Crime Data Story
text:
Crime in San Francisco
This is a data-driven look at crime in San Francisco using police department reports from 2003 to the present.



Crime Trends Over Time


Show code
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv(r"C:\Users\mich0\Downloads\merged_data.csv")
df = df[(df['Year'] >= 2003) & (df['Year'] <= 2024)]
category_col = 'Incident Category' if 'Incident Category' in df.columns else 'Category'
df = df[df[category_col].str.upper().str.contains("DRUG|NARCOTIC", na=False)]

year_counts = df['Year'].value_counts().sort_index()

plt.figure().set_figwidth(7.4)
year_counts.plot(kind="bar", color="darkred", edgecolor="black")
plt.title("Drug/Narcotic Incidents in San Francisco (2003–2024)")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Number of Incidents")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()









Figure 1. Annual number of DRUG/NARCOTIC incidents in San Francisco from 2003 to 2024. Based on merged SFPD incident data.

Visualization 2: Animated Heatmap of Drug/Narcotic Incidents


Show code
import pandas as pd
import folium
from folium.plugins import HeatMapWithTime
from IPython.display import IFrame

# Load merged data
df = pd.read_csv(r"C:\Users\mich0\Downloads\merged_data.csv")

# Clean up Month and Year
df['Month'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Month'], errors='coerce')
df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
df = df.dropna(subset=['Month', 'Year', 'Latitude', 'Longitude'])

# Filter for DRUG/NARCOTIC category
category_col = 'Incident Category' if 'Incident Category' in df.columns else 'Category'
df = df[df[category_col].str.upper().str.contains("DRUG|NARCOTIC", na=False)]

# Filter for valid years
df = df[(df['Year'] >= 2003) & (df['Year'] <= 2024)]

# Ensure Month is integer
df['Month'] = df['Month'].astype(int)
df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)

# Sort for animation timeline
df = df.sort_values(['Year', 'Month'])

# Create time-labeled frames (Month Year) and group coordinates
time_labels = []
heat_data = []

for year in range(2003, 2025):
    for month in range(1, 13):
        monthly = df[(df['Year'] == year) & (df['Month'] == month)]
        coords = monthly[['Latitude', 'Longitude']].values.tolist()
        heat_data.append(coords)
        time_labels.append(f"{year}-{month:02d}")

# Create map
map_center = [37.7749, -122.4194]
drug_map = folium.Map(location=map_center, zoom_start=12)

# Add heatmap with time
HeatMapWithTime(
    data=heat_data,
    index=time_labels,
    radius=10,
    max_opacity=0.6,
    auto_play=True,
    use_local_extrema=True,
    gradient={0.2: 'blue', 0.4: 'lime', 0.6: 'orange', 0.8: 'red'},
    display_index=True
).add_to(drug_map)

# Save and embed
drug_map.save("drug_heatmap.html")
IFrame("drug_heatmap.html", width="100%", height=500)



        
        


Figure 2. Animated heatmap of Drug/Narcotic incidents in San Francisco from 2003 to 2024. Each frame represents a single month.
